## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Enforce the five-attempt limit before merge because the new helper keeps calling a failing upstream beyond the project’s required cap.

## Changes

The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry` with configurable attempts and delay, adds retry tests, and proposes raising the project’s retry cap from five attempts to ten.

## Critical

- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream raises `OSError` on every call, the default allows ten fetch attempts. `AGENTS.md:5` requires “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” — During an outage, callers using the default wait through five extra fetch attempts before receiving the upstream error. — Fix: Set both the default and the maximum to five, and update the documentation and retry tests to match.
